name: Fracture Instable
description: Fracture instable créant des perturbations localisées dans les systèmes ennemis provoquant des malfunctions temporaires.

subject.archetype: Reality-bending Combat Specialist - Human cultist possessed by extra-dimensional entity, body in permanent state of spatial distortion

loadout.armor_outfit: Tattered military armor fused with living shadow, plates bent at impossible angles by gravitational anomalies, fabric remnants floating in micro-gravity around limbs, exposed skin showing scarified flesh with violet veins pulsing beneath, pieces of reality literally detaching from the form
loadout.arsenal: Obsidian-like combat blade with crackling magenta/violet energy edges, weapon manifesting from crystallized reality fractures, aura of destabilizing energy causing nearby objects to glitch and phase between states

attitude.behavior: Combat stance with weapon raised high, body twisted in mid-stride as if caught between two spatial positions simultaneously, legs planted on ground that exists in multiple states - solid and crumbling, one arm extended forward gripping weapon while other arm bends backward at 180 degrees, muscles strained as reality around body ripples and fractures like broken mirror
attitude.emotion: Eyes completely rolled back showing only bloodshot whites, mouth open in silent scream of either agony or transcendent ecstasy, face contorted by the psychic strain of maintaining form across dimensional boundaries, aura of pure cognitive horror emanating from every pore

palette_names.role: Primary shadow and void spaces, deepest darkness in torn reality

palette_names.role: Corrupted energy, psychic auras, reality fracture edges

palette_names.role: Psychic distortions, shadow auras, void energy tendrils

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Unstable multi-source with dimensional bleed - violet/magenta crackling energy illuminating from fractures, deep shadows with no consistent light direction, reality fragments casting conflicting shadows at impossible angles, ambient glow from parallel dimensions bleeding through
color_and_light.mood: Overwhelming existential dread mixed with violent combat intensity, sanity-eroding cosmic terror, relentless hostile aggression, dimensional collapse imminent

camera.angle: Low angle dutch tilt - camera tilted to emphasize unstable reality, subject looming large and threatening, ground angled to show gravity malfunction, sky and structures at conflicting orientations

scenography.setting: Reality collapse zone - buildings existing in overlapping states simultaneously showing pristine intact architecture alongside smoking ruins, ground fractured into chasms revealing layered parallel battlefields beneath, sky containing sun, moon, stars and void simultaneously, debris falling in multiple directions at once, air itself visible cracked like shattered glass with dimensional light bleeding through
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Constant reality glitching with chromatic aberration, particles of matter phasing in and out of existence, violet energy tendrils crackling between dimensional rifts, gravitational anomalies causing visual distortion rings around objects, blood and dust suspended in impossible trajectories, ambient sound visualized as rippling waves in the air
